text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Liamine Zeroual suspends a draft law on land until after the elections. The draft law providing for renting land has angered several social associations grouping most of Zeroual's backers.

- Air Algerie is expected to resume flights to Paris within 45 days. The Algerian airline had suspended flights to the French capital since 1995 following a row with the French aviation authorities over security measures.
- The National Liberation Front (FLN) party starts selecting its candidates for the forthcoming parliamentary elections.
- According to a U.S.-based finance study institute report, Algeria has successfully achieved the first stage of its economic stabilisation reforms and has begun the second stage of broad reforms.
- The Transitional National Council resumes session on Monday to vote party and election laws.
